note: ESTIMATE: simulated power; compute MEASURED. Model-based Monte Carlo (#5): 96 design points, 1,000 planted-effect studies each, from Atlas frozen 4408ff0, real verified upmc source. SYNTHETIC Weibull outcomes (shape1.5), HR2 per frozen source SD; finite-bank approximation (64 acquisitions per source patient/design). Computed Monte Carlo estimates, not observed clinical rates. 10,000 calibration +10,000 independent global-null +1,000 planted-effect studies/design; 95% binomial intervals condition on source, bank and realized calibration. Cox U uses permutation variance (legacy R4); this is not an R15 score-screen power result. UPMC is descriptive and uses the historical pre-lock 50 verified cases; no locked-validation claim.

meta.method: Model-based Monte Carlo: each point is the share of simulated studies, re-imaged from real cells with planted Weibull outcomes, in which the maxT test rejects. A simulation estimate under the stated model, not an observed rate, whatever the source label.
meta.source: Atlas frozen 4408ff0, real verified upmc source

model.censoring_tail_policy: administrative horizon = stratum maximum observed follow-up

meta.source_scope: historical pre-lock verified-source cohort; frozen authorized production run
meta.censoring_tail: administrative horizon at stratum maximum follow-up
meta.mc_interval_scope: conditional on source, acquisition bank and realized calibration; excludes source and bank-construction uncertainty
meta.method_check_scope: paired differences with conservative 95% bounds; interval containing zero does not establish equivalence
meta.direct_check_scope: bank and direct imaging use the same bank-derived cutoff
meta.statistic: legacy R4 Cox U with conditional-permutation variance; not R15 Cox-information Schur Z
